source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Components of a Home Network' of 1.9 as printed (PDF 17, printed 12).

blocks.text: A home network has different important components. A router connects all devices in the network. A modem connects the home network to the internet service provider. Computers, laptops, and mobile phones are network devices. Network cables are used for wired connections. Wireless devices use Wi-Fi signals to connect.
